mapper.select:
WITH target_deck AS ( SELECT id FROM decks WHERE id = #{deckId} AND delete_batch_id IS NULL ), active_cards AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT cards.id, cards.deck_id, cards.front, cards.back, cards.is_flagged, cards.example, cards.hint, cards.pronunciation, cards.created_at, cards.updated_at FROM cards INNER JOIN target_deck ON target_deck.id = cards.deck_id WHERE cards.delete_batch_id IS NULL ), page AS ( SELECT active_cards.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_items FROM active_cards ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{page.limit} OFFSET #{page.offset} ) SELECT id, deck_id, front, back, is_flagged, example, hint, pronunciation, created_at, updated_at, total_items, TRUE AS deck_exists FROM page
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, COUNT(active_cards.id), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_deck) FROM active_cards WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM page)
ORDER BY created_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC NULLS LAST
